creator: gemsonvhs
caption:
John Prine & Iris DeMent - “In Spite of Ourselves”

	Today we’re looking back on a duet between two legendary figures of folk music. John Prine wrote this humorous track while recovering from radiation therapy and surgery on his throat. In a 2016 interview, he recounted requesting Iris Dement to join him on the track, “I kinda had her voice in mind when I was doing it because I know Iris can be a little sassy and she could tear this guy down… I told Iris, ‘I want you to listen to this and just see. It’s got a few questionable things in it that you’re gonna have to say. So you just tell me whether you would want to do it or not. We’ll leave it at that... So I didn’t hear from her for three weeks. Nothing. Finally, I called her and I said, “Iris?” And she said, “Yes?” I said, “Well?” And she said, “Not while my mother’s alive!” Then she ended up doing it anyway.”

We’d like to thank our patreon supporters for allowing us to bring you all posts like this one.

- Nick @ Gems

caption:
🧱 2026/04/09
•
What if Spiders Wove with Strings?🕷️
【如果蜘蛛可以用弦結網？】
•
This is a hand-tracking audio and visual interactive system where users control digital spiders with their hands. At the center of the visual is a bio-inspired, algorithmically generated 3D web. As a spider’s body approaches the nodes, legs emerge and grow, where the number of legs modulates the pitch and effects—as if they were standing on musical strings.
•
The two spiders can interact, flirt, or engage in courtship, with their proximity altering the sound’s waveform. Upon physical contact, their bodies fuse together, triggering chemical transformations in their coloration and the web’s structure, while evoking deep resonant tones.
•
這是一個手部追蹤的視覺與聲音互動系統，使用者可以透過雙手控制數位蜘蛛移動。畫面中間是一座仿生演算法產生的三維蜘蛛網，當蜘蛛的身體靠近節點時會生長出腳，腳的數量會對音高與效果器產生變化，就像是讓他們站在弦上
•
兩隻蜘蛛可以相互玩耍、調情或求偶，他們的距離會改變聲音的波形。碰觸到彼此的身體會融合在一起，色澤與蜘蛛網的結構也會產生化學變化，並且會觸發共鳴聲
